pages.text: Paint brushes let you paint blocks in whatever color you like!$(br)$(br)Dab your paint brush in a Paint Can made in the Paint Mixer then click on a block to paint it.$(br)$(br)Canvas blocks are
pages.title: item.openblocks.paintbrush

pages.text: perfect for painting, but you can also paint quite a few vanilla blocks and even some blocks from other mods. You can also place stencils on blocks and then paint over the stencil!
